hadith:
Companions of the Prophet - Abu Bakr:

Look at Muhammad through his family (i.e. if you are no good to his family you are not good to him).
message:
# Spiritual Reflection

Remember that all benefit and protection come solely from Allah's will, not from our own efforts alone. As Al-Muhaymin, the Guardian, Allah protects and preserves all creation, so place your trust in Him and be grateful for the good He grants you. Let this knowledge humble your heart and inspire you to use His blessings wisely, treating others—especially those close to you—with kindness and integrity as a reflection of your faith.
name:
Al Muhaymin - الْمُهَيْمِنُ - The Guardian

The name Al Muhaymin originates from the Arabic root 'h-m-n', which means to guard, protect, or supervise. In the context of Islamic theology, it reflects Allah's ability to safeguard and preserve the universe and everything within it. It embodies reassurance for believers that their affairs are under divine protection and that Allah is aware of all actions and intentions.
verse:
Al-A'raf - The Heights - 7:188-190

Say, “I have no power to benefit or protect myself, except by the Will of Allah. If I had known the unknown, I would have benefited myself enormously, and no harm would have ever touched me. I am only a warner and deliverer of good news for those who believe.”

He is the One Who created you from a single soul, then from it made its spouse so he may find comfort in her. After he had been united with her, she carried a light burden that developed gradually. When it grew heavy, they prayed to Allah, their Lord, “If you grant us good offspring, we will certainly be grateful.”

But when He granted their descendants good offspring, they associated false gods in what He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate ˹with Him˺!
